Method of Attack: Disguised as a modified version of the Tor Browser to scam users
Pretends to connect to a fake onion site
Does not use Tor but connects to a remote FTP server to retrieve fake marketplace content
Mimics a Dark Web marketplace to trick users into placing orders and paying via Bitcoin for products they never receive
Stores user passwords and private messages in cleartext
All site content is downloaded from FTP or web server in text, Base64, or encrypted HTML files
Impacted Systems: Users looking to buy illegal products off the Dark Web using the fake Tor Browser
Attack Vector: Distributed via YouTube videos instructing users to download the fake Rodeo Browser
